# Advisories with no patched release.
#
# One id per line: GHSA-..., CVE-..., or PYSEC-.... Blank lines and lines
# starting with # are ignored. List every id a scanner actually emits for
# that advisory (OSV may report the CVE while npm audit reports the GHSA).
#
# An entry suppresses that advisory on push, pull request, and the daily
# schedule. Do not add an id that has a patched release — bump the lockfile
# instead, and delete the entry once a patch exists.
#
# The scheduled Security workflow still scans every lockfile. It fails, and
# therefore emails, only for an advisory that is not listed here and was
# absent from the previous scheduled scan. Push and pull_request fail on
# every advisory that is not listed here.
#
# Nothing is ignored right now. The advisories that failed the scheduled run
# on 3706ea5 all have patched releases and are pinned in the lockfiles.
